messages:
Sam (People Ops): Quick thread: finalizing how managers should submit reviews for folks with leaves, conversions, or short tenure. Need consensus before I publish the how-to.
Ivy (Eng Manager): Please make it easy to flag and attach 1-3 artifacts. Also want an explicit field for conversion date when relevant.
Noah (PM): Agree. For new hires under 90 days, default to 'New hire <90d' but allow an observational note. Don't force a score.
Sam (People Ops): Plan: add a required dropdown (Full cycle / Partial data (LOA) / New hire <90d / Contractor->FTE / Insufficient data). Require 1-line rationale and allow up to 5 evidence links. Prefill LOA/conversion dates from HRIS where available.
Raj (HRBP): Operational rules: LOA = >30% of period. Contractors who converted = record conversion date. Provisional ratings allowed but must be checked with "Flag for calibration". Add a hidden "PIP during cycle" flag visible only to HR/calibration reviewers.
Ivy (Eng Manager): Will the form auto-check "Flag for calibration" when Partial or Contractor->FTE is chosen? We had missed a few last cycle.
Sam (People Ops): Yes 12 we'll auto-check by default and managers can uncheck after confirming. Also adding inline guidance: "If provisional rating assigned, explain why and flag for calibration."
Noah (PM): Exception process? My lead is on emergency leave and I can't finish forms by deadline.
Raj (HRBP): Managers can request a 7-day extension via the Helpdesk link on the forms page. For urgent cases escalate to your HRBP. We'll include a short exception form to capture reason and expected completion date.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: review forms due in 48 hours. Forms: https://docs.internal/redwood/reviews/forms. Request extension: https://helpdesk.internal/redwood/review-exceptions :bell:
Sam (People Ops): I'll roll the update in 30 minutes and send a one-pager + examples (LOA, new hire, conversion). Ping me if you want a 5-min walkthrough before I publish. :thumbsup:
